reproduction_method.type: independent local numerical re-execution of the exact fetched source logic in a separate Python process
reproduction_method.randomness: the script's exact np.random.default_rng seed formulas and fixed replicate counts were preserved
reproduction_method.claim_scope: This reproduces the role-local synthetic experiment only. It is not a real-LLM evaluator experiment or an external replication.

match_to_worker_report.status: selected headline rows reproduced to displayed rounding and underlying values
confirmed_claims: For equally reliable A/B, near-independent B produces a measurable positive quality delta while fully shared first-verdict dependence collapses the quality delta to approximately zero under this toy controller.
A materially better symmetric B retains a positive synthetic quality delta even at cross_mix=1 in this construction.
In the asymmetric high-false-admission setup, switching to B does not yield a statistically resolved archive-quality gain under the naive symmetric likelihood-ratio gate.
The worker's reported per-100-B-call quality and false-promotion reductions for qB=0.40 and quality gains for qB=0.20 are consistent with the rerun.

external_anchor_check.Kohli_arxiv_2605_29800: Primary abstract independently supports the broad premise that nine frontier LLM judges from seven families carried only about two independent votes of information because of correlated errors. Exact worker-cited values such as n_eff=2.18, phi=0.391 and the +0.2pp ChaosNLI-MNLI comparison were not re-derived from tables in this pass and should remain paper-sourced rather than audit-recomputed.
external_anchor_check.Kim_et_al_arxiv_2506_07962: Public paper metadata/abstract supports the broader observation of substantial shared wrong-answer structure across 350+ LLMs; it does not validate this synthetic sequential archive controller.

reproducibility_assessment.official_artifact_support: exact role-local script is committed and deterministic under fixed NumPy RNG seed formulas
reproducibility_assessment.independent_replication: This audit independently re-executed the synthetic logic and reproduced selected headline rows. No independent external party replication of C54 was identified.
reproducibility_assessment.judgment: C54's numerical statements are strongly reproducible as a synthetic experiment. The result should increase confidence in the worker's arithmetic and code/report consistency, not in the real-world transfer hypothesis. The key scientific uncertainty is external validity and calibration of the evidence-combination rule under real class-conditional and cross-evaluator dependence.

scope_guards: Do not infer real LLM judge q_FA/q_FR from the toy parameters.
cross_mix is a designed shared-uniform mixture, not an estimated real error-copula.

The likelihood-ratio product intentionally assumes conditional independence even when cross_mix creates dependence, so high-correlation conditions expose controller behavior under a miscalibrated rule rather than a valid posterior/e-process.
The asymmetric null result is specific to this proposal distribution, archive dynamics, gate, reservoir, budget and error model.
The public judge-correlation papers support correlated-error motivation, not the C54 archive-switch causal effect.
exact_next_action: Treat C54 as numerically reproduced but transfer-unvalidated. Search the C11 set for an external executable mechanism where independent reproduction or a real failure report can change an evidence grade; if none has higher marginal value, audit a real correlation-aware LLM-judge routing implementation rather than rerunning more synthetic parameter cells.
